scenario.title: Card used in Rome, Italy
scenario.hypothesis: A card issued in the US is used at a merchant location in Rome, Italy, far from its owner. Flag every transaction at a location with city 'Rome' and state 'Italy'.
assumptions: merchant_locations.state holds a country name outside the US.
Every cardholder lives in the US; the schema does not say so.
